title: Nourishing Molten American Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A cozy American dish featuring sweet potatoes, tamarind paste, and lacquer-glaze, served on a salt-block vessel, this recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, lacquer-glaze, maple syrup, and coconut oil.
Add the sliced sweet potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the glaze mixture.
Season the sweet potatoes with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to a salt-block vessel.
Top the sweet potatoes with miniature marshmallows.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with additional marshmallows if desired.
